profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at SILAC Insurance Company
profile.summary: Well polished skills across several emerging technologies that allow fast development and integration of information systems and digital business solutions. Excellent performance in fast paced development teams. First hand experience with highly available cloud solutions. An avid attitude towards customer satisfaction as well as effective and efficient businesses solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implementation of critical contracting software infrastructure for federal agencies like the National Institutes of Health and Veteran Affairs.

Experiment with Rust-Lang and developed an internal aggregative rating application based on Elo.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented software solutions for the loan servicing industry. My responsibilities include design and development of internal web solutions and reporting services built with Microsoft's MVC 5, Angular.js, Knockout.js, NHibernate, Castle Windsor(ioc).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Development of highly available Billing Service for the Windows platform including database code first implementation with EntityFramework, development and deployment of cloud services
● Work extensively on the .Net environment of development tools.
● Scheduling of highly redundant services and clusterization through the Quartz.net framework and API
● Implementation of a secure Windows Communication Foundation service with high load support
● Front end design and development with Angular.js, and javascript
● Vast experience with versioning tools and their respective workflows (Git/Sourcetree)

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description:
● World class customer attention.
● Achieved a high level of effectiveness in conversion of calls to sells.
● Acquired an excellent understanding of customer needs in the utilities field.
● Developed an avid, responsible and prompt response attitude towards customer needs.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help facilitate education in STEM fields for children K-12.
Tutoring students with subjects uncommon for the Guatemalan high school curriculum
